name: Voltage-measurement merging-unit publisher
summary: Publishes the assigned sampled voltage quantities from the selected measurement interface.
description: Publishes the assigned sampled voltage quantities from the selected measurement interface. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Local voltage measurements” at the input and “Published sampled voltage stream” at the output. Voltage reference and phase identity must be retained.
